checkpoint_selection: last epoch fixed before training; internal validation never selects pilot checkpoint
labels: GT point membership [start,end); shortest containing GT for distance regression, deterministic tie by start/end. Outside GT is benchmark relevance zero, not certified semantic absence.
loss: Unweighted BCE mean per video; smoothL1 normalized left/right offsets on positive points only; 1-IoU on positive decoded spans. Mean video losses per update, batch one video, AdamW.
input: normalized frozen v, broadcast q, v*q, dot(v,q), actual PTS/duration, preceding PTS gap seconds; no GT to inference
mechanical_gates: finite forward/loss/gradients, train loss decreases, exact checkpoint reload logits, all decoded floating-second spans in duration; losses are mechanical sanity not localization/generalization gains
diagnostics: same-feature E4; last-checkpoint query zeroing and frame reversal while holding PTS fixed. Interventions are sensitivities, not retrained ablations or semantic negatives.
scope: 32 frozen official-train sources only; no old80/fresh80 evaluation, VLM requests or image/text encoder training
